T: Don't make a sound. Not even when you chew.
D: A family lives in silence on a farm to avoid blind creatures that hunt by sound.
P: Serve the mains when the family eats dinner off leaves instead of plates.
S: the Abbotts serve dinner on leaves, no clattering plates
Butter lettuce cups filled with soft rice, shredded poached chicken, cucumber and herbs, dressed with lime and fish sauce. No crunch anywhere.
Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, with a soft cheese dip of cheddar melted into evaporated milk.
the corn silo, minus the danger
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, poured into a buttered mini muffin tin and baked at 200C for 12 minutes. Soft, not crunchy.
M: caught at the river by the waterfall where they can talk
Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and garlic, wrapped in foil with butter, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, opened at the table. New potatoes on the side.
a pot that cooks without a sound
Beef chuck browned, onion, carrot and celery, stock and thyme, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until it falls apart. Soft polenta underneath.
W: Yolks whisked with sugar and cornflour, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat until thick, vanilla added, chilled in cups with poached pears.
K: the only loud place in the film
Chilled sparkling water poured slowly over cucumber and mint, so nothing clinks.

s.note: the Abbotts serve dinner on leaves, no clattering plates
s.how: Cook 200g jasmine rice. Poach a chicken breast gently and shred. Spoon rice and chicken into butter lettuce leaves with thin cucumber, mint and a dressing of lime juice and a little fish sauce. Nothing crunchy anywhere.
Brush 4 soft pretzels with butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth. Serve warm, and dip quietly.

m.note: caught at the river by the waterfall where they can talk
m.how: Stuff 2 whole trout with lemon slices, dill and sliced garlic. Dot with 40g butter and wrap each in foil. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes and open at the table. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with butter.

w.how: Poach 2 peeled, halved pears in sugar syrup for 15 minutes. Whisk 4 yolks, 80g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour. Pour over 400ml hot milk and 100ml cream, then stir over low heat until thick. Add vanilla, chill in cups and top with the pears.

d.note: the only loud place in the film
d.how: Put a few cucumber ribbons and mint leaves in each of four glasses with no ice, so nothing clinks. Pour chilled sparkling water in slowly down the side. Sip without a sound.
